Task: OCR and Layout Extraction

Write Python code that extracts blocks, lines, tables, or layout elements from a document using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai
from google.cloud.documentai import Document, Page, TextAnchor, BoundingPoly

def extract_layout(text_uri: str) -> Document:
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    name = "projects/<PROJECT>/locations/<LOCATION>/processors/<PROCESSOR>"
    with open(text_uri, "rb") as image:
        image_content = image.read()
    raw_document = Document(content=image_content, mime_type="application/pdf")
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=name, raw_document=raw_document)
    result = client.process_document(request=request)
    document = result.document
    return document

def print_layout_elements(document: Document) -> None:
    for page in document.pages:
        for block in page.blocks:
            print(f"Block confidence: {block.confidence}")
            print(f"Block text: {block.text}")
            print(f"Block bounding box: {block.bounding_box.vertices}")
            for paragraph in block.paragraphs:
                print(f"  Paragraph text: {paragraph.text}")
                print(f"  Paragraph bounding box: {paragraph.bounding_box.vertices}")
                for word in paragraph.words:
                    print(f"    Word text: {word.text}")
                    print(f"    Word confidence: {word.confidence}")
                    print(f"    Word bounding box: {word.bounding_box.vertices}")
        for table in page.tables:
            print(f"Table bounding box: {table.bounding_box.vertices}")
            for header in table.header_rows:
                print(f"  Header text: {header.detected_text}")
            for row in table.rows:
                print(f"  Row text: {row.detected_text}")
        for visual_element in page.visual_elements:
            print(f"Visual element bounding box: {visual_element.bounding_box.vertices}")
        for formula in page.formulas:
            print(f"Formula text: {formula.detected_text}")
            print(f"Formula bounding box: {formula.bounding_box.vertices}")

<PLACEHOLDER> = "<PROJECT>, <LOCATION>, <PROCESSOR>"
